description: This file defines the 'Span' interface and related types for OpenTelemetry tracing, including span kinds, links, and methods for span operations.

methods.name: LinkFromContext
methods.description: Creates a Link object encapsulating the SpanContext from a given context with optional attributes.

methods.name: ValidateSpanKind
methods.description: Coerces an invalid SpanKind value to the default internal kind.
